messages:
tony: started canary rollout of v4.1 to eu-west ~10m ago. quick healthchecks green but smokebot reported intermittent 502s on /v1/generate.

deploy-bot: Deploy v4.1 deployed to canaries (4/4). tag: v4.1.0.

smokebot: synthetic-run -> route /v1/generate returned 2 failures of 6 samples; failing samples from euw-can-01. p95 ~2.3x baseline.

mei: looking at proxy logs: repeated "upstream reset" for host euw-can-01 around rollout timestamp. also kv miss rate spikes on the same host.

tony: can someone run a focused probe against euw-can-01? I'll paste the curl.

tonY typo -> ton y -> ton y: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://euw-can-01.api.redwood/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -d '{"prompt":"smoke-probe"}' -w "\n%{http_code} %{time_total}\n"
```

mei: probe results x3: 200 0.22, 502 0.45, 200 0.20. intermittent failures.

ops-bot: Host euw-can-01 reports kv_prefill_worker_count=1 backlog=8.

mei: hypothesis: prefill workers lagging on that node caused first-request failures. trigger targeted prefill and rerun synth.

tony: running targeted prefill now. output: "queued 5 prefixes -> processed 5 -> done in 18s".

smokebot: re-run synthetic -> 6/6 success for /v1/generate on euw-can-01. p50/p95 within normal.

mei: recommendation: continue rollout but hold general roll for 15m observation and pin v4.1 to canaries for 6h. add note to internal changelog: transient kv prefill backlog on euw-can-01 caused intermittent 502s; mitigation: targeted prefill and increased startup concurrency in follow-up.

tony: +1. i'll enable a temporary alert for route p99 and kv_prefill_backlog>5 for 6h.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollforward to remainder of eu-west in 15m from 6156000060.

mei: oncall checklist: 1) monitor p99 2) confirm prefill drain on new hosts 3) if failure rate >4% over 5m, halt and investigate.

tony: i'll draft the internal release note: "v4.1.0 - gradual roll. Note: transient kv prefill backlog observed on canary euw-can-01 affecting /v1/generate; targeted prefill executed and verification passed. Rollout resumed with 15m observation and 6h canary pin."

mei: filing INFRA-6790 to track improving prefill visibility and parallelism.

tony: customer blurb: small, canary-only hiccup resolved prior to general rollout. will coordinate with comms.

smokebot: reaction :white_check_mark:.

ops-bot: reminder: keep release notes internal until 6h observation completes.

mei: i'll watch channel for the next hour. ping me if alert fires.

tonY: closing thread after observation window if stable.
